title: Rocket to the Red Planet

pages.text: Captain Leo put on his shiny silver helmet and stepped into his cardboard rocket ship.
With a '3... 2... 1... BLAST OFF!', the backyard transformed into a sea of twinkling stars.
He zoomed past the glowing moon and landed softly on the dusty red surface of Mars.
There, he found a friendly purple alien who wanted to play a game of space-tag!

moral: With imagination, the whole universe is your playground.
